title: Local cohomology on the closed subsets defined by an ideal and its extension agree under scalar restriction
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the two local cohomology functors attached to an ideal and to its extension under a ring map agree on the induced module structure (author lemma at source lines 1541-1552, label lemma-local-cohomology-and-restriction). The proof (source lines 1554-1576) gives two arguments: uniqueness of adjoints for the two functors, and an explicit identification of the alternating Cech complexes attached to generators (proof lines 1554-1575). Both routes are spelled out in the counted text. H3.
